title: CQ-M: Profiles, matched measurement, rollout
description: Profile selection, whole-task usage attribution, a frozen representative baseline and gated measured promotion. Final task owns full-system acceptance.
architectureNotes:
Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Implementation checkpoint 2026-10-24 / source35cf53c: six source tasks (F01,F02,M01a,R02,R02p,C00) are independently QA-approved and locally landed on moe/work-2026-10-24. Final exact-HEAD Linux archive regression:2521 daemon tests passed,9 skipped (one pending F05, eight pre-existing);97 Node tests passed; typecheck and role lint passed. This is NOT full rollout or trusted-runner certification. verified-local remains unconditionally unavailable; no actual VM provisioning or JetBrains archive build was certified. Neither Multipass nor Java is exposed on PATH in this WSL execution environment; native host setup remains unverified. Git push lacks credentials; designated local delivery succeeded, do not rebase a shared checkout. Linux tests must use separate native dependency installation with unchanged lockfile/source hashes, not overwrite original Windows node_modules; Linux-only Node/system PATH avoids inherited Windows-directory EACCES in accounts CLI tests. Next snapshot chain is M01b-f then originalM01 context/docs integration; snapshot configuration is not approval or verification proof. Preserve legacy/observe live delivery-policy behavior and do not rank unrelated delivery policies with generic max().

Every task owns tests; exactly one final integration/hardening task per epic. Shared schema/protocol changes get broad regression.
Preserve legacy policy. No unsupported isolation downgrade or caller-minted trusted evidence.
Parallelize only file-disjoint implementations. Serialize overlapping affectedFiles through explicit dependencies; preserve peer/pre-existing bytes. No Git writes outside wrappers.

[CQ-TOKEN-v1] Consider token efficiency in every task: reuse still-valid approved plans and fresh sourced context; prefer bounded targeted queries and concise deltas/log references. Avoid unchanged replanning, broad rereads, payload dumps and unnecessary model/subagent calls. Respect routing floors and required final/shared-contract verification; use focused checks during iteration.

[CQ-TOKEN-SAFETY-v1] Optimize total tokens/cost per independently accepted change, not shortest prompts. Never weaken behavior, approved scope, freshness, approval, tests or evidence, or omit mandatory context. Context selection belongs in daemon packets with visible omissions, never launcher/CLI field loss or truncation.

[CQ-TOKEN-MEASURE-v1] Count planning, retrieval, repair/retry and all participating-agent usage, including cached/uncached input and output. Cached tokens still occupy context; missing counters remain unknown. Compare usage with independently assessed quality, human repair and latency; claim savings only with matched evidence.
